source: A {0} value reaches the client only if it is assigned before the shell is flushed: in a plugin, in route middleware, or in {1} before any {2}. A later assignment, for example in an async component under {3}, is dropped, and logs a warning in development. A cookie assigned before a server-side {4}, or before an error raised before the shell is flushed, is sent with the redirect or error response.

Un cookie assigné avant un {4} côté serveur, ou avant une erreur levée avant l'envoi du shell, est transmis avec la réponse de redirection ou d'erreur.
